ops.body: A4+A8 (b9f39d6f) sol-reviewed. A4.1 fix round queued after A3.1 (both precede the release): (1) BUG: Comparability config_hash covers only primary_metric+tiebreak — a changed task or arm set silently reuses stale baselines; fix = hash the ENTIRE BakeoffSpec (over-invalidation safe); (2) BUG: concurrent BaselineStore.put leaks raw sqlite3.IntegrityError instead of BaselineConflict (get+INSERT non-atomic; Store's lock is per-instance and wraps single executes) — fix = atomic INSERT OR IGNORE + read-back-compare; (3) baseline-store accessibility moves into train preflight so a paid run can't abort post-training on metadata I/O; (4) mirror_cc_notes gets a CLI/nightly wire-through (currently SDK-only). Rejected: float-tolerance on frozen values (exact identity IS the freeze contract; recomputed values take the get path), near-zero uplift rescaling (floor design as chosen). Confirmed clean by the same review: uplift math exact both directions incl. negative baselines, settings-driven baseline_root, clean missing-baseline path, mirror passthrough default-safe, no dangling Qwen3-9B refs. Codex's A8 deferral was corrected separately: the real model is qwen3.5-9b (HF + mlx-community repos verified live), riding with A3.1 gated on a Tinker-catalog check.
